chunks: And ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a woman with a husband who committed zina, became pregnant, and when she gave birth, secretly killed her child. He said: “She is given one hundred lashes because she committed zina, and she is given one hundred lashes for killing her child, and she is stoned because she is muḥṣanah.”

He said: And I asked him about a woman without a husband who committed zina, became pregnant, and secretly killed her child. He said: “She is given one hundred lashes because she committed zina, and she is given one hundred lashes because she killed her child.”

key_terms.ذَاتِ بَعْلٍ: a woman who has a husband
key_terms.غَيْرِ ذَاتِ بَعْلٍ: a woman who does not have a husband
key_terms.مُحْصَنَةٌ: legally married and protected through marriage
key_terms.مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ: one hundred lashes as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a married or unmarried woman who commits zina and then secretly kills her child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who commits zina, bears a child from it, and then secretly kills the child. It distinguishes between a married woman and an unmarried woman, assigning lashes in both cases for zina and killing the child, while adding stoning for the married woman on account of being muḥṣanah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5031 - It is narrated by Asim ibn Humayd from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that he was asked about a married woman who committed adultery and became pregnant. After giving birth, she secretly killed her child.
Imam (as) said: 'She is to be lashed one hundred times for committing fornication, another hundred lashes for killing her child, and she is to be stoned because she was married (muhsanah).'
I then asked him about an unmarried woman who committed fornication, became pregnant, and then secretly killed her child.
Imam (as) said: 'She is to be lashed one hundred times for committing fornication and another hundred lashes for killing her child.'
